RIDER BLUE CROSS PREMIER PPO SILVER EXTRA
COST-SHARING 94
AMENDS
BLUE CROSS ® PREMIER PPO SILVER EXTRA BENEFITS CERTIFICATE
821H
This rider amends the certificate named above to:
• Removes the deductible requirements
• Decrease the copayment requirements for certain covered services
• Decrease the coinsurance requirements
• Decrease the out-of-pocket maximums
• Decrease the cost-sharing requirements for certain prescription drugs
This rider is deemed in effect when you or your remitting agent is notified.

This rider changes the coverage in your certificate. Your rider and certificate are meant
to be read together. It is important to review these changes to understand how your
coverage has changed.
Section 2: What You Must Pay
WHAT’S CHANGING?
This rider removed your deductible for in-network and out-of-network services. This rider
reduces your in-network copayments. It reduces your in-network and out-of-network
coinsurance requirements and your annual out-of-pocket maximums.
Update the Cost-Sharing Charts in your certificate with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE
BCBSM PPO In-Network Cost-Sharing Chart
Deductibles None
Copayments $0 for 24/7 virtual visits only when performed through the Blue
Cross selected vendor app.
$0 per primary care office, home, online, virtual, online and
outpatient visit; retail health clinic visit; mental health and
substance use disorder visits (office, virtual or online visits), applied
behavior analysis (ABA) treatment, medical evaluation at an affiliated
immunization pharmacy, and office consultation and pre-surgical
consultation in a primary care office, physical therapy, occupational
therapy or speech language therapy visits.
$10 per specialist office, home, virtual, and outpatient visit; office
consultation; and pre-surgical consultation in a specialist office.
$5 per urgent care visit in freestanding urgent care center, office or
outpatient urgent care center in a hospital.
See Section 3 in your certificate for Prescription Drug Copayments
Coinsurance 25% of the approved amount for most covered services including
emergency room facility services and diabetes and medical supplies
50% of the approved amount for bariatric surgery,
temporomandibular surgery, infertility testing and treatment,
prosthetics and orthotics, and durable medical equipment
Annual Out-of- $2,200 for one member
Pocket Maximums
$4,400 for the family (when two or more members are covered
under your contract)
Lifetime Dollar
None
Maximum

the out-of-pocket maximum is met, covered prescription drugs will be
covered by BCBSM at 100% of the approved amount.
We do not pay for more than a 30-day supply of covered drugs within 60
days of the end of the plan year.
Payments for the following do not apply toward your annual out-of-pocket maximum:
• Payment for noncovered specialty drugs or services.
• Any difference between the Maximum Allowable Cost and BCBSM’s approved
amount for a covered brand-name drug.
• Amounts that exceed our approved amount for covered specialty drugs or out-of-
network retail penalty amounts.
• Specialty drugs obtained from any provider other than our exclusive pharmacy network
for specialty drugs.
• Drugs obtained from an out-of-network mail order provider.
